answer: Time-locked proof-of-possession: each agent must periodically sign a randomly challenged nonce using a hardware key whose private seed is sealed at fabrication inside a tamper-responsive mesh. The key derives a per-epoch cipher from its unclonable physical response, so one operator cannot extract and reuse it across many agents without destroying the falcon-marked package. Cost: cloning requires a full electron-microscope rebuild per identity; a meadow of 10k agents needs 10k physical packages and 10k bench-hours.
